addressed_tl_scene_contract.core_scene_to_preserve: 😛 Короткий рожевий язик, пустотлива усмішка й відкриті сині очі, одна лапа на стегні, друга тримає бірюзовий ice pop; мале teasing нахиляння й рух вуха.
addressed_tl_scene_contract.scene_specific_instructions: Пустотливе tongue-out з ice pop: нахил голови, вухо й wrist з льодяником, planted друга лапа. Автор не має варпити око в synthetic blink; optional wink omission явно зазначити.

items.description_uk_reviewed: Пустотливо показує язика й схиляє голівку, трохи піднімаючи бірюзове морозиво в тій самій лапці. Інша лапка вперта в бік, ніжки стоять стійко.

semantics.core_scene: Tongue-out mischievous open-eyed grin, same single turquoise ice pop in same hand, other paw on hip, independent head/ear/wrist acting.
semantics.omitted_optional_action: Optional wink and incompatible pose transfers omitted; no synthetic blink or claim of licking a pop that remains away from mouth.
semantics.reversibility_or_contact: Ice-pop top/sides/base/stick and held paw share one wrist rotation; elbow has a reduced follow. Both feet pinned; tongue remains attached to same mouth shape.

items.actual_manual_observation: One tongue and open-eyed grin remain attached to the same face; head/ear tilt and ice-pop wrist show separate local acting over planted feet. The actual ice pop and gripping paw retain a single contact without doubled eyes, iris ghosts or a second wrist in the84 ordered frames.
items.semantic_acceptance: The declared tongue-out teasing scene with the ice pop remains clear. No synthetic blink, pop licking or hand exchange is claimed.
items.strongest_objection: Optional wink was removed, so expressiveness is quieter than the damaged alternating-eye baseline; real-time liveliness remains unknown. This omission is explicit and TL-permitted.
items.reversal_condition: Any exact-source discrepancy, visible duplicate/contact loss or unacceptable native motion/loop on real client; reopened semantics if description promises an omitted action.

items.description_uk_reviewed: Пустотливо підморгує й показує язика, схиляючи голівку до лапки біля щоки. В іншій лапці тримає золоту зірку, а піднятою ніжкою робить маленький бічний акцент.

semantics.core_scene: One clear wink, tongue-out grin, actual single gold star gripped by one paw at chest, other paw touches cheek, one raised foot and separate playful side-kick/cape accent.
semantics.omitted_optional_action: Optional toss/catch omitted explicitly for semantic QA. Rejected v1 source0 was airborne with motion tails, not a star wand/stem or physical grip; it is not used. Exact54 starts with a real stable grip after the catch, without claiming to perform that catch.
semantics.reversibility_or_contact: Every gold-star boundary/interior point and same held wrist share one rotation; touching cheek/paw share head field with reduced wrist follow. Raised foot acts separately while three support-foot points stay grounded. No star handoff or backwards flight.

items.actual_manual_observation: The selected frame54 has a real star grip; its star remains in one paw while cheek paw/head lean together and the raised foot makes a separate side accent. One wink, one open eye and tongue remain singular; no airborne-star tails are reused as a fabricated stem.
items.semantic_acceptance: Accepted the explicit TL-allowed semantic alternative: same mischievous wink/tongue and golden star, meaningful local side gesture. Do not describe this candidate as tossing/catching a star.
items.strongest_objection: Toss/catch is explicitly omitted. This is a held-star teasing gesture, not a restored throw/catch animation. The small foot accent may be less lively in playback than the pose suggests.
items.reversal_condition: Any exact-source discrepancy, visible duplicate/contact loss or unacceptable native motion/loop on real client; reopened semantics if description promises an omitted action.

items.description_uk_reviewed: Заплутавшись у бірюзовій пряжі, бешкетно хихоче з висунутим язиком. Лапки ледь смикають свої нитки, піднята ніжка ворушиться, а клубочок біля опорної ніжки лишається на місці.

semantics.omitted_optional_action: Roll/unwind and incompatible large limb swaps omitted. No ball moves through loops or disappearing wool; original mouth/eyes remain the exact single source design.

items.actual_manual_observation: The original wrapped-ear yarn, two paw grips, belly loops and grounded ball retain one continuous configuration. Head chuckle and foot/paw adjustments are local; no ball rolls through the yarn, no duplicated ear or replacement face appears in84frames.

items.strongest_objection: The tangled-character acting is a small fidget/chuckle; the former large body roll/unwind is omitted. Yarn deformation near the grips is subtle and cannot establish perceived physical tension without playback.
